name: spellkave_grant_role
label: Grant role
description: Delegate a role through a binding-only manifest delta as the caller. Exact covering frontier.bind.<role> OR all nonempty merged role ids admit the request; no apply or prune privilege is required. Whole-world extent * requires complete inventory and never covers later roots or bundles.

argumentGates: Actual role, old/new binding coverage, batch bounds and destination-instance guards are checked by D-6 on the server.
